simple.meaning: פִּשְׁתָּה (pishtâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “flax ; by implication, a wick.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פִּשְׁתָּה (H6594) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 9:31, with occurrences in Exodus, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פִּשְׁתָּה (H6594) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פִּשְׁתָּה (H6594) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פִּשְׁתָּה (pishtâh) / H6594 is traced through Exodus 9:31, Isaiah 42:3, Isaiah 43:17 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
